description: Register a new ECS task definition revision (image tag and/or env var changes), drive a rolling service update, poll stability and health gates, and auto-rollback to the previous task def revision if any gate fails.

container_name.label: Container Name
container_name.description: Target container name. Required when image_tag is set and the task def has more than one container. Defaults to the first container.

image_tag.label: Image Tag
image_tag.description: Full image string to deploy, e.g. nginx:1.27. At least one of image_tag or env_var_overrides must be provided.

env_var_overrides.label: Env Var Overrides
env_var_overrides.description: List of {key, old_value, new_value} objects. old_value is a safety guard — the executor raises if the current value does not match.

target_group_arn.label: Target Group ARN
target_group_arn.description: ALB/NLB target group ARN. If provided, all targets must be healthy before the deploy is declared successful.

health_check_url.label: Health Check URL
health_check_url.description: HTTP endpoint to probe after stability. GET must return health_check_expected_status.

stability_timeout_seconds.label: Stability Timeout (seconds)
stability_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for ECS deployment stability (default 300).

health_timeout_seconds.label: Health Timeout (seconds)
health_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds per health gate — applied independently to ALB gate and HTTP probe gate (default 60).

region.label: AWS Region
region.description: AWS region. Defaults to connector credential region.

rollback.description: Call update_service with old_task_def_arn from execution_result to restore the previous task definition revision.
